name: pastillero-digital
description: Pastillero digital web local: rutina de medicación con supervisión familiar

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run demo -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm start -w server" "npm run preview -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
